description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class EmployeeLicenseDao that manages database operations related to employee licenses within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee license records, as well as obtaining allowed licenses for employees.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object managing employee license data, including CRUD operations and search functionality within the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeLicense entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeLicense entity based on employee number and license ID, or returns null if not found.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee license entries for a given employee based on provided license IDs.

methods.name: searchEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Searches for employee licenses based on filter parameters and returns matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee licenses matching the search filter.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicenses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of licenses that are allowed for an employee, based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeAllowedLicensesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed licenses for an employee based on filter parameters.
